include.description: relative YAML files under instance/ merged into this house file

extends.description: the id of a parent profile in profiles to inherit defaults from

kind.description: what it is (tv, avr, streamer, hdmi_matrix and so on), which gives it its place in the semantic model

controls.description: the integrations that read it (observe) and command it (control)

config.description: integration-specific device settings, keyed by integration name

speaker_audio.description: whether the TV's own speakers are used: false gives it no volume or mute of its own, and true is the same as leaving it out

inputs.description: HDMI inputs the TV offers (e.g. hdmi1..hdmi4); defaults to hdmi1 through hdmi4

items.description: an HDMI input name such as hdmi1

remote_layout.description: remote layout: android_tv or nvidia_shield; inferred from make when omitted

udn.description: the player's UDN, by which its events are told from another's: RINCON_, its mac in capitals without the colons, then 01400; derived from mac when omitted

model_profile.description: capability profile: soundbar (TV input, subwoofer/surround settings) or amp; inferred from model when omitted

zones.description: how many zones the receiver has, the main zone included: 1 to 4, and 2 when left out

inputs.description: SI input codes the receiver offers; overrides model defaults

items.description: a receiver SI input code such as BD or MPLAY

has_diagnostics.description: whether the receiver supports read-only AppCommand0300 signal diagnostics; overrides model detection

pid.description: the receiver's HEOS player id, as HEOS get_players reports it: a whole number, never 0

bridge.description: whether this receiver carries the house's HEOS connection: true on one receiver, left out on the others

model_profile.description: capability profile: amp_pro, mini or generic; overrides model detection

inputs.description: inputs the projector offers (e.g. hdmi1, hdmi2); defaults to hdmi1 and hdmi2

items.description: an input name such as hdmi1

scaler.description: the default scaler for every output, including the value restored after a source-specific hdmi_audio_scaler

hdcp.description: the HDCP version the outputs ask for, in quotes

ports.description: number of [inputs, outputs] when different from 8x8
number of [inputs, outputs] when different from model detection or 4x4

package_camera.description: whether a doorbell has a second camera, for packages

via.description: the device id of a Global Caché emitter device to inherit ip and model from

connector.description: which of the emitter's connectors points at the device: 1, 2 or 3

profile.description: the file of verified IR commands, as ir/<name>.json under instance/

model.description: the emitter's model when not inherited from via

ip.description: the emitter's IPv4 address when not inherited from via

matrix.description: the device id of the HDMI matrix; derived from routing.hdmi_matrix when omitted

input.description: the matrix input the source is on; derived from routing.sources.<id>.hdmi_input when omitted

scale.description: display temperature unit for the remote UI

step.description: setpoint step size in raw units for UI +/- buttons

settle.description: per-value settle time overrides in ms

monitor.description: how closely it is watched: optional keeps a device known to be broken out of control health and its alerts, and required is the same as leaving it out

reboot.description: when thermite restarts it, while it is idle: each night, once part of it has hung while the rest answers, or both

notes.description: whatever its owner wants to remember; no program reads it

control4.description: the Control4 driver name that thermite control4 summary suggested; no program reads it

label.description: the room's name, as people read it

tag.description: its openHAB Location tag (Room, Kitchen, Building and so on), which places it in the semantic model

in.description: the room id of the room or building it is part of

id.description: its name in thermite: snake_case and its own; every Item of the device starts with it

room.description: the room id of the room it is in

later.description: devices not set up yet: their ids are kept for them and discover knows them, and nothing is generated for them

items.description: a device to be: an id, and whatever is known of it

services.description: the ids of Things in conf/ that belong to no device, which validate then accepts

theme.description: the colors of the remote: a built-in theme's name, or a theme file under instance/

diagnostics.description: what else is known about the picture's path

observers.description: devices that report on the signal passing between two others

items.description: an observer and the two devices it sits between

after.description: the device id the signal comes from

before.description: the device id the signal goes on to

after_port.description: the upstream output when that device pair has several connections

before_port.description: the downstream input when that device pair has several connections

after_zone.description: the upstream receiver zone when the device pair is ambiguous

before_zone.description: the downstream receiver zone when the device pair is ambiguous

protect.description: the UniFi Protect console the cameras are on; its credentials are not kept here

port.description: the console's HTTPS port; 443 when left out

routing.description: which source each room can show, and how it gets there

hdmi_matrix.description: the device id of the HDMI matrix the rooms share; a house without one leaves it and hdmi_off_input out

hdmi_off_input.description: the matrix input a room's output is turned to for Off: one with nothing on it

usb_off_host.description: the USB matrix host port a room's device ports are parked on: one with no computer on it

edid.description: each source's matrix input presents the EDID of the display it is turned on in; {} for that alone

idle.description: the EDID an input presents while no room shows its source: one of the matrix's EDID names

sources.description: the sources, by the device id of each

label.description: its name on the rooms' Source selectors

hdmi_input.description: the HDMI matrix input it is cabled to; a source without one is cabled to a room

usb_host.description: the USB matrix host port its computer is on, or one for each USB matrix

idle.description: what becomes of it when no room shows it: preserve leaves it on (as when left out), standby puts it in standby

rooms.description: the routed rooms, by room id (or a name of its own, with room)

room.description: the room it is in, for a routed room that is not a room of its own (a desk's screen in an office)

label.description: its name on the remote, where that is not its room's

hdmi_output.description: the HDMI matrix output its screen is on; without one it offers only sources cabled to it

hdmi_audio_output.description: a second matrix output, to its receiver, for a room whose picture and sound leave the matrix apart

hdmi_audio_scaler.description: what the scaler of its hdmi_audio_output does while it shows some of its sources from the HDMI matrix (audio-only for a computer whose picture its receiver need not convert); any other choice, Off included, gives the output the matrix's settings.scaler back

additionalProperties.description: one of the HDMI matrix's scaler names

hdmi_switch.description: the HDMI switch in front of its display, or one output of a matrix of its own

output.description: which output of a matrix of its own the room is on

matrix_input.description: the switch input the house's HDMI matrix or previous switch arrives on

inputs.description: the sources cabled to the switch, each on its input

hdmi_switches.description: cascaded HDMI switches or downstream matrices in front of its display, ordered upstream to downstream

items.description: an HDMI switch or downstream matrix output

usb.description: its USB device ports (keyboard, camera), by USB matrix

additionalProperties.description: the matrix's device ports that are this room's

usb_only.description: sources that move only some of those ports

additionalProperties.description: the ports that source moves, by USB matrix

usb_unused.description: what becomes of the ports a source does not move: preserve leaves them where they are (as when left out), park moves them to usb_off_host

sources.description: the sources it offers, in the order its selector shows them

items.description: a source: a key of routing.sources

sleep_sources.description: sources of this room alone that are put in standby when it turns Off

edid_by_source.description: the EDID each named matrix source presents while this room uses its own feed, even when another room selects the same source

additionalProperties.description: one of the HDMI matrix's EDID names

audio.description: the device its Volume and Mute drive: a soundbar or streaming amplifier in a room it covers, or its own receiver or display

carries.description: what a source's signal carries to it where that is not both picture and sound: display for a picture alone (a computer whose sound stays with it), audio for sound alone; a display source's path leaves out the room's audio device, which plays none of it

audio_input.description: the input of its audio device that its route feeds (optical, for a streaming amplifier on its HDMI switch's audio out); without it, any sound that device plays with no track named is taken to come from the route

audio_link.description: the known physical audio branch to its audio device, independent of volume control

from.description: the device and output connector feeding the audio device

port.description: the native output connector name or number

zone.description: the receiver's zone this room listens to: 2 or more, and left out for the main zone
